notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY！！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ! I am soraki ! Thank you for reading~~

"Parhelion" is my first game work. I have previously considered whether to release this rough game with a too fast pace and a weak plot. However, after thinking about it for a long time, I decided to release it. In this game, I want people other than me, maybe friends or strangers, to play my game, feel my world view and outlook on life, and witness the final results of the characters I created. 

So, after receiving the love and support from many friends, "Parhelion" was born ! !

But, my game currently only supports Chinese, I'm sorry! But I have an idea to make an English version! This may take me a few months! So sorry for those who speak other languages!
​
